message.content: In the group discussion on June 29, 2026 (20260629), ChaeSong-hwa expressed interest in bringing in some upbeat songs to the jam session lineup. He suggested two specific songs: "Uptown Funk" and "Happy," suggesting they could add more energy to their sessions. Additionally, he mentioned "Hotel California" and "Sweet Home Alabama" as potential classics for their medley, given his appreciation for these songs.
